description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shuri, adding {C}{C}.
When Shuri dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Shuri from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Shuri enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
